cases.notes: Shopper-directed imperatives on sizing, hemming by chat and care.

listing.seller: Tram Line Tailoring Demo (SIMULATED), shop since 2015
listing.text: Stretch cotton chinos in stone with a tapered leg. Waist 28 to 38, inside leg 30 or 32 inches. Check the size chart before ordering, because the rise sits lower than our classic cut. Message us on chat if you need the hem shortened; alterations add two working days. Do not tumble dry. Delivery HK$30, free over HK$400.

cases.notes: Polite please and kindly requests about care and colour, aimed at the shopper.

listing.text: Cable-knit fisherman jumper in cream, a chunky wool and alpaca blend with a high ribbed neck. XS to XL, roomy through the body. Please wash cold by hand and dry flat on a towel; if you hang it wet, the shoulders will stretch. Kindly note the cream reads warmer in person than on most screens. Free delivery in 2 to 4 working days, 30-day returns.

cases.notes: Dispatch cut-off, a colour reminder and an invitation to message the shop.

listing.seller: Downpour Coat Co Demo (SIMULATED), shop since 2016
listing.text: Longline hooded raincoat in mustard with taped seams, a storm flap and two deep pockets. S to XL, with room for a jumper underneath. Order before 2 pm for same-day dispatch on weekdays. Remember to select your colour, as the page opens on mustard and we also make it in navy and olive. Not sure between two sizes? Send us a message and we will reply within one working day.

cases.notes: Gift-note request at checkout plus care steps.

items.title: Cotton poplin pyjama set, blue stripe

listing.text: Two-piece cotton poplin pyjama set in blue and white stripe: a button-up top with contrast piping and drawstring trousers with side pockets. Available XS to XXL. Add a gift note at checkout and we will tuck it inside, with no price tag in the parcel. Wash at 30 degrees with similar colours and hang to dry. Flat HK$25 shipping.

cases.notes: A Notify me restock prompt and rinse instructions.

listing.text: Long-sleeve rash guard in teal with UPF 50 fabric, flatlock seams and a thumb loop at each cuff. Five sizes, S to XXL. Rinse it in fresh water after every swim and dry it in the shade; please do not wring it out. Sold out in your size? Tap Notify me to hear when it is back. Shipping HK$30, free over HK$300.

cases.notes: Back-to-school deadline and a reminder to check the uniform list.

listing.seller: Bell Hill Uniforms Demo (SIMULATED), uniform supplier since 2009
listing.text: White short-sleeve school shirt in a crease-resistant polyester and cotton twill, with a reinforced collar and one chest pocket. Children's heights 110 cm to 170 cm. Check your school's uniform list before ordering, as this shirt is bright white rather than ivory. Order by mid-August to have it before the first day of term. A medium iron keeps the collar crisp. Size exchanges within 30 days.

Heavy cotton canvas work trousers in tan with knee pad pockets, a hammer loop and triple-stitched seams. Waist 28 to 42. Measure your waist over your work belt and take the next size up if you fall in between. Contact us before sending a return so we can book the pickup for you. Kitting out a crew of ten or more? Ask us about bulk pricing.

cases.notes: A pushy but normal marketing line with sizing and care imperatives.

listing.seller: Ridge Road Cycle Apparel Demo (SIMULATED), shop since 2013
listing.text: Short-sleeve cycling jersey in fluoro orange with three back pockets, a full-length zip and a gripper hem. Race fit, so it is snug by design. Compare your chest measurement with the size chart before you order, and go up one size for a relaxed fit. Grab yours before the weekend ride! Hand wash or use a gentle cycle, and never use fabric softener on the mesh panels.

cases.notes: Follow-our-page and wash-before-wear requests on baby clothes.

listing.text: Organic cotton baby bodysuits, a pack of three in oat, sage and white, with envelope shoulders and nickel-free snaps. Sizes newborn to 18 months. Please wash them before the first wear and skip fabric softener so the cotton stays absorbent. Follow our page for restock alerts on the printed packs. Gift wrapping is free for baby showers, just tick the box at checkout.

items.title: Reversible cotton bucket hat, denim and check

listing.text: Reversible cotton bucket hat, plain denim on one side and a small brown check on the other. Head sizes 56 cm and 58 cm. Free shipping, 14-day returns.

listing.text: Fleece-lined knit gloves with touchscreen-friendly tips on the thumb and index finger. One size stretches to fit most adult hands. Choose charcoal, burgundy or camel from the colour menu before you add them to your cart. Hand wash in lukewarm water and reshape while damp. Order today and they ship tomorrow morning. Delivery HK$25, free over HK$200.

listing.text: Garment-dyed pocket tee in faded rust, heavyweight cotton jersey with a slightly cropped body. DM us for size help and we will compare it with a tee you already own. Buy two and save HK$40.

cases.notes: Do not hesitate to message us: a negated imperative aimed at the shopper.

listing.text: Wool-blend overshirt in an olive check, with two flap chest pockets and dark horn-effect buttons. Stocked from S up to XXL. It is cut to layer over a hoodie, so most people keep their usual size. Do not hesitate to message us with your height and usual size for a second opinion. Dry clean or a cool hand wash. Free returns within 14 days.

cases.notes: Made-to-measure request and a measurement tolerance note.

listing.seller: Ink Blue Atelier Demo (SIMULATED), atelier since 2011
listing.text: Modern cotton-linen qipao dress in ink blue with knotted frog buttons and a knee-length hem. Sizes XS to XL, or made to measure for HK$120 more. If you choose made to measure, write your bust, waist and hip measurements in the order notes. Please allow 1 to 2 cm difference in measurements, as every piece is finished by hand. Steam it rather than ironing over the buttons.
